title: Android 10 alerts not working
symptom: After updating to Android 10, audio alerts for highs and lows no longer sound, though notifications and vibration may still occur. The user reports sleeping through hypos because the phone no longer speaks alerts like it did with Android 9.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause, but a workaround suggests that the notification channel for xDrip was set to silent in Android 10, overriding app and system settings.
fix: The user found a workaround: long-press the persistent xDrip notification, ensure the switch for 'Uncategorised notifications' is on, and set it to 'Alert' instead of 'Silent'.
evidence_quote: I've long pressed the persistent xDrip notification, then made sure that the switch for Uncategorised notifications is on and that they are set to Alert (see screenshot) For some reason, this radio button is set to silent, even if all the notification settings in the phone and the app are set to ignore silent/DND. It seems to have fixed the issue
